about: Starting point for the next client's plan, learned from the user's corrections on AC#6, AC#7, AC#8 (24 Nov 2026). Not a final benchmark: half of each consistent median gap is applied, then the measured grade and the user's review decide. The one-off AC#6 Exposure -0.2 / Shadows -3 fix is excluded.

office.evidence: Exposure +0.4 median (n 13, all 3 clients raised it, +0.1..+0.6); Tint -2 median (n 9, mixed sign: AC6/AC7 down, AC8 up -> half, measure per clip); skin Hue +2.4, Lum +4.2 (AC7)

greenscreen.evidence: Exposure +0.25 median (n 10, 3 clients); the same look set by hand on AC6/AC7 green screens: Highlights -7, Shadows +9, Whites -10, Blacks +5; skin Lum +5

outdoor.evidence: Temp limit +15 was always pulled down (to 4.2..8.4, 3 clients); Tint +10 -> 0; Saturation +8.8 median (n 6, all +); Exposure +0.22 median (mixed)

trim.out: User moved OUT earlier every time (5/5, -2.3..-8.2 s, median about -3 s): people stand up / look aside after the last word. Engine trim v2 checks the face in the pause and looks back up to 10 s.
trim.in: One VG IN moved to 0 (AC7 VG4062).
